decisions.question: PAR-C01 (model compaction, D9) is built and reviewed but deviates from the approved SPEC 0290 in 4 points: (1) the context/compacted event keeps 4 fields, without pinnedDigest/model/usage, because the session schema is closed and mirrored in the Python SDK; (2) the compaction call does not appear as model/request in the kernel log, though it is charged to the budget; (3) the summary is capped at 4000 characters instead of 2048 output tokens, because ModelRequest has no maxTokens; (4) a prefix bigger than the window is refused instead of summarized in chunks. Accept?
grants: integrar a C01 com os desvios 1–4 como limites declarados, todos fechados por recusa
cartão de acompanhamento: schema de sessão v2 com pinnedDigest/model/usage no context/compacted, maxTokens no ModelRequest e fatiamento do prefixo
aceite dos desvios 1–4 da SPEC 0290 na entrega da C01 (fatias 1–3, P2 de retry corrigido)
does_not_grant: mudança do schema de sessão ou do SDK Python nesta onda
o desvio 5 (throughSequence = posição na lista), que fica como cartão próprio
